title: Beyond SMP - Essential
description: The official lightweight modpack for the Beyond SMP. Includes all required mods needed to join the server while remaining lightweight and performance-friendly.
body:
# Beyond SMP – Essential

Welcome to the official Beyond SMP – Essential modpack!

Beyond SMP is a Minecraft Java server inspired by Attack on Titan and Avatar: The Last Airbender, combining Titan powers, elemental bending, exploration, factions and community events into one multiplayer experience.

The Essential edition is the recommended modpack for most players. It contains every required mod needed to join the server while remaining lightweight, stable and performance-friendly.

Unlike the Enhanced edition, this pack focuses on smooth gameplay rather than visual improvements, making it ideal for lower-end and mid-range PCs.

## features ##

* ⚔️ Attack on Titan gameplay through Danny’s AOT Mod.
* 🌊 Avatar-inspired elemental bending.
* 🏰 Official mods required to join the Beyond SMP.
* ⚡ Performance-focused client configuration.
* 🧭 Quality-of-life improvements.
* 🎮 Fabric 1.21.1 support.
* 🛡️ Officially maintained by the Beyond SMP team.
* 🔄 Updated alongside every server update.

### Why download? ###

Instead of installing dozens of mods manually, this pack includes everything required to join the Beyond SMP in one download. It is designed to provide a simple installation process, excellent performance and maximum compatibility with the server.

### Enhanced Edition ###

If your PC has more graphical power, check out Beyond SMP – Enhanced, which includes multiple shader packs, Distant Horizons, visual improvements and additional client-side features while remaining fully compatible with the server.

### Credits ###

A huge thank you to danny7_7 for creating Danny’s AOT Mod, which makes the Attack on Titan gameplay in the Beyond SMP possible.

Thanks to all of the amazing mod developers whose work is included in this modpack.
